name: TD Aeroplan Visa Business Card

credit_required.notes: Canadian resident who has reached the age of majority in their province or territory.

base_rate.description: 1 Aeroplan point per $1 on all other eligible purchases.

categories.label: Air Canada purchases including Air Canada Vacations (bonus rates share an $80,000 annual cap)
Participating Hyatt hotels and resorts (first $80,000 a year)
Travel and transit, dining, EV charging, shipping, internet, cable and phone services (bonus rates share an $80,000 annual cap)

rewards.redemption_notes: Aeroplan points redeem for Air Canada and partner flights and other Aeroplan rewards.

signup_bonus.description: 10,000 Aeroplan points after the first purchase, 30,000 after $15,000 in the first 180 days, and 20,000 after $25,000 in the first 365 days.

notes: The issuer page does not name a network package tier, so network_tier is none.
